headline: Brent crude briefly tops $119 per barrel, before receding, and shakes stock markets worldwide
summary: Oil prices jumped to market-shaking levels above $119 a barrel before easing back late in the day, helping Wall Street pare its losses.
why: Brent is the main international crude benchmark, used to price much of the world's oil. Sharp moves in Brent feed into inflation expectations and equity market risk.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Brent briefly surged above $119 before retreating during the session.
